prediction_vs_result.predicted: The disclosed diagnostic outcome is already known: expect the same complete correspondence and overlap when recomputed after the declaration commit.
observed: All 30546 captured native steps from all 60 members are represented, at all 105 merges.
All 62 pair/pattern files have identical SHA-256 values to the retired diagnostic: True. Every stored recurrence array is identical: True.

failures_only.scope: Original-model observations only. No weight edit, new answer, capability repair or held-out generalization measured in this run.
failures_only.coverage: No captured native step or source member omitted; this does not assert that generation-limited source responses were complete answers.

what_this_changes: The correction target and native-step correspondence are available from a precommitted calculation without losing intermediate source steps or rewarding longer positive-similarity paths.
The recurring separation survives the correspondence correction, which does not itself establish a causal capability signature or a successful repair.
Construction must use native individual states/inputs and one averaged target per native step, not replace those states with the per-axis group summary.

reporting_yardstick.measured_from: recurrence.npz and the existing split-half baseline derivation
reporting_yardstick.derivation: Average expected squared distance between two halves of a group, 4*spread/n, over the two groups; this is twice the full-group sampling-variation estimate. This is a descriptive expectation, not a significance test.

limitations: Global DTW matches all steps but does not establish causal or semantic identity.
The reference axis is one wrong answer. A correct native step can be repeated over several axis places; original identities and multiplicities are retained in the pair files.
A shortened natural response must not be called repaired merely because it can be stretched over the reference axis.
Neighboring axis positions and related question variants are not independent samples.
Fable reviewed the numerically identical retired diagnostic and highlighted the single-axis stretching limitation; no places were excluded by hand.

solver_interface.recurrence: recurrence.npz: gap, chance, halves, within, shared_part
solver_interface.native_targets: pipeline.overlap.complete_overlap.native_targets(place_values,pairs,steps); mask place targets before averaging, then use each native input/state exactly once
